notes: Arithmetic is printed as shown. '11.5-13=(-)1.5' is the printed form: the negative result is written in parentheses after the equals sign. Preserved verbatim, not corrected.
Formula cells are printed with irregular spacing ('13-4=9', '11-6=5', '8.5-7=1.5'); spacing is preserved as printed.
Blank cells are printed blank; no dashes or zeros have been supplied.

The table is printed under the 'Hydraulic grade line original' chart of Figure 4.16. Both Figure 4.16 tables are landscape inside a portrait page; the region bbox is in unrotated page coordinates and the evidence crop is read after rotating it 90 degrees.
Unnumbered table embedded in a figure; p303-1 is a service locator, not a printed table number.

Friction loss, earth cover and pipe diameter values are printed centred in the A, B and C columns (per-reach rows); they are placed under A, B, C as printed. No reach-to-column mapping is asserted beyond that layout.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 200-600 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed page is landscape; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell/term against 144-dpi region renders and 200-dpi rotated crops; confirmed all values and printed anomalies. Corrections: added layout note for per-reach rows
